note: STAND-IN. This file does not come from an entelos release.
Entelos has no release with the signed activation record yet (mohanraj00/entelos#105 and mohanraj00/entelos#155).
The record has the layout of tests/activation_record_stand_in.json, the stand-in of the activation seam test. The test of this example compares the two field lists.
A record has no signature, and the names and the layout of the fields are an assumption of this project.

To replace it: pin the entelos release in examples/library_hours/requirements.txt, make the record with that release, and change only the function `activation_of` in examples/library_hours/library_hours.py to read the released layout.
All values are synthetic and neutral.
names: A value that starts with `$` is a name. The example binds it to a reference or a candidate identity of its own store, because these values depend on the content of the store.
